text: Account for disruption and wider effects
After this you can include disruption, adaptability and wider stakeholder effects in a comparison.

For education only; this is not legal, purchasing, financial or safety advice. Consider normal operations and disruptions. Resilience concerns continuity and recovery after a failure; flexibility concerns shifts in demand. Cost-effectiveness weighs the results achieved against full cost and uncertainty. Wider stakeholder effects may include inclusive participation, accessibility, environmental impact and community outcomes where relevant. Avoid adding unrelated criteria merely to increase the count. Consider who carries each risk, and whether incentives reward real outcomes rather than easy-to-inflate activity counts.

items: The four principles can be made more concrete by selecting measurable requirements that matter for the case.

text: Make disruption risks and relevant wider stakeholder outcomes part of the decision record.
